newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Three new shares to debut on Slovenia's OTC.
newsitem.headline: Three new shares to debut on Slovenia's OTC.

text.p: Slovenian trading company Jadran, chemical maker Melamin and poultry farmer Jata Meso will list their shares on Ljubljana's over-the-counter (OTC) market on September 23, the bourse said on Monday.
Jadran will list 241,423 shares with a nominal value of 1,000 tolars ($7.4) per share, accounting for 64 percent of the company's equity capital.
Melamin will list 306,883 shares with a nominal value of 1,000 tolars each, representing 66 percent of the firms equity capital.
Jata Meso will list 53,005 shares with a nominal value of 10,000 tolars per share, representing 58.04 percent of the company's equity capital.
The bourse said it expected about another 10 listings of newly privatised firms by the end of the year.
Currently there are 24 shares traded on the primary market and 20 on the OTC market.
